title: Two G4466 dips lack stable 1–2-day returns in a tested TESS depth filter
abstract: We test stable repeats of two resolved dips in the published TESS sector 52 light curve of G4466. Gaussian fits give depths near 0.09 and widths near 0.136 day. In the primary depth filter, both events have median return depths below half the observed depth at all 10,000 sampled periods from 1 to 2 days. Two larger background windows leave small period sets unresolved: 23 and 12 trials for one event exceed half. At injected periods of 1, 1.5 and 2 days, none of 100 stable phase trials per event falls below half with the primary window. A weakest-return test has many false rejections. Longer periods have weak coverage. This exploratory test concerns fixed Gaussian trains at known phase and period. It is not a blind search or a confidence exclusion for all dust patterns. It does not determine orbital radius, dust lifetime or dust source. The package contains the licensed input, code, full return profiles, injection controls, source hashes and reproduction steps.

display.caption: Local dip fits and median depth ratios at predicted returns.
